verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax's own docs say it can be used in a sandbox environment to preview automatic tax calculation behavior under different tax settings. A sandbox is by nature separate from live production, so this covers the core of the story. The evidence is a single sentence from the testing page, with no detail on how isolated the sandbox is. missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox data is isolated from production, detail on which Tax APIs and features behave the same in sandbox, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You can use Stripe Tax in a sandbox environment to preview automatic tax calculation behavior for different tax settings.
